nom: RMS Beauty ReFresh Eye Brightener Broad Spectrum SPF 30

avis.texte: I was shocked by how much this has become a must have for me, even on days i dont wear makeup. Covers any undereye darkness and also has the added spf protection in the place i need it the most. After applying with the metal applicator, i do have to go over and blend it out with a brush. Lasts all day. This will be a definite repurchase for me.
I'm enjoying this product now that I purchased the right color. If you are looking for exceptional coverage/ correction I do think there are better brands for that if you have serious darkness.
I love this. My dark circles are intense and this doesn't completely cover them, but the color is perfection and it's just moisturizing enough under my hard core concealer
Great product. I love using this before going out for the day to garden.
This is a very nice powder for dry skin, It sets my makeup without making it look or feel dry.
I am pretty shocked how much I am enjoying this product! I have grown to love rms but under eye products I still was unsure if I would like it.
Amazing product! Goes on so smoothly, does great job on morning puffiness and defuses dark circles! Love that metal ball so much, it feels amazing to roll it under eye to depuff
It goes on beautifully. Think I got the wrong color be very careful.

avis.titre: Love the product, not the applicator
avis.texte: This is probably one if the nicest concealers I've used. I love the formula. It covers well and doesn't look cakey or dry. It feels very nourishing. The only think I don't like about this product is the applicator. I don't see the point to the ball because it doesn't roll over the skin and kind of drags if you try. It just seems a bit gimmicky. You're better off applying with the warmth of a fingertip or the utility of a brush.
Another amazing bonus to my makeup routine the texture is flawless, and the ingredients are perfect

OMG! This is a really, great product! I am always looking for a proper concealer to cover my hereditary dark circles (think panda eyes). When this product came out, I was curious but since it was expensive, I held back. Recently it came on sale and I went ahead and ordered it. I am so glad I did! This doesn't just conceal, it corrects. And, let me tell you that makes a ton of difference. It means that I don't have to worry about shifting the concealer layer accidentally and that the dark circles will perk through. I apply a think layer and wait for a few seconds and the transformation is unbelievable. I have not been using my Hydra concealer since I bought this item. It's easy to apply and I just use my ring finger to tap it into the skin. Just sharing one last thing about my experience in case someone else has the same problem - I ordered 'Hush' based on the recommendation on the website and the RMS foundation I use. It left a whitish residue (meant too light for my dark circles). I am medium skin toned but my dark circles are really dark (again, think panda eyes)👀. I got 'Swoon' and it made a huge difference in the overall look. The product color corrects and matches my medium skin tone. It looks natural and not like I have piled on anything on my eyes. I am in love! I think I found the perfect product for the first time!
I really like it! I bought Adora color and it looks at 1st as if it would be to much color but it blends very nicely. I love that it has SPF already.
This product, kept cold in the fridge, reduces morning puffy eyes 100%!! And applying it feels so soothing and lovely. 5 stars!

avis.titre: The best under eye treatment ever
avis.texte: The best! I love this, the product is so smooth and brightens my under eye area. It is replacing my concealer. I liked it so much I bought a second one to have in my travel makeup kit.
I appreciate the spf and wear it on days I know I will have sun exposure. Not sure I can convince myself of its brightening effects. . .

I don't have very dark circles, but I love the way this brightens the undereye area. I can use it on its own for no makeup days or with my makeup for more coverage. I have the lightest shade and fair to light skin.

avis.titre: Works well…. stays where it's placed.
avis.texte: Works well…. stays where it's placed. I like the metal tip for applying

I was hesitant to try this but once I did, WOW! I love that my under eyes now have spf protection as I was always hesitant to use my normal spf there. This brightens and covers with such a light/dewy, second skin texture that I even find myself patting it on other areas of my face on "no makeup" days when I'm still out running errands and needing spf. It provides light coverage alone and boosts any concealer/foundation layered on top. Totally recommend!

This eye brightened is my holy grail corrector. I want spf for my under eye that looks smooth and actually color corrects. Looks great, doesn't settle into fine lines under the eyes. Wears well under my concealers. I purchased the shade Cherish and it suits my undertone beautifully. I wear RMS foundation in shade 22for reference.
Unbelievable! First use and immediately saw a difference. I love this product!

avis.titre: A Redefining Eye Brighter and So Much More.
avis.texte: I absolutely love this Refresh Eye Brighter Broad Spectrum under eye corrector. It works wonderfully. The functionality is so state of the art. I love the cool metal tip. It's very refreshing to have this extra bonus. Plus it doesn't dry my under eyes. I love that you can wear it alone or use 1 of 2 or both other RMS concealers based on your need and want.
I like the product. It's a thicker consistency but blends out nicely to hydrate and cover any discoloration under the eyes. The metal ball provides an additional soothing sensation.
This is skincare for your eyes plus spf with staying power! My holy grail!

This undereye concealer did not work for me. It provided little coverage. I think in general liquid concealers are less effective than creams (at least for my eyes). I could still see my dark circles under the 'bag'.
First time using the brightener and it feels and blends in nicely. Also, love how it makes my eye area look.
I love Refresh Eye Brightener! It delivers far more than I expected, finally an under eye corrector that really works and looks natural! It's the best of the lineup of under eye treatments!

Love the Refresh eye brightener! It is light and airy, not heavy and waxy. It brightens my eyes and helps me look refreshed. Does not settle into the fine lines around my eyes and decreases the appearance of my eye bags. I definitely recommend and will definitely buy again.
Very neutral feeling on the product. I did not see a difference under my eyes after use. The cooling rolling applicator feels nice but product itself doesn't work for me.
The ReFresh Eye goes on very smooth and the roller is wonderfully calming for the skin around my eyes.

avis.titre: Best product for dark eye bags
avis.texte: I never realized that I needed this. I watched Rose Marie demonstrate it and I had to give it a try! It's the best thing for my under eye darkness. Sometimes I don't use a concealer. I keep it in the refrigerator so the metal tip is nice and cool. Try it you will be so impressed!!
Definitely a repeat purchase! The Refresh Eye Brightener makes my eyes look refresh instantly! Softens the look of fine lines and makes eyes look awake and skin area smooth.

This is my absolute favorite makeup product of all time!! It's absolutely brilliant! Blends in so nicely, BRIGHTENS the eyes and makes them look so alive. I love that it has spf in it to protect the skin from sun damage too. I will forever and always use this product I hope it never goes away!!
I love it. It so moisturizing and brightening and feels so good around my eyes.
This works so well to brighten. It doesn't settle in my fine lines or stick to dry areas. I love it! And spf is a added bonus!!

Could not ask for a better understanding eye concealer and corrector. If you watch Rose Marie apply her products, and you should, you will learn exactly how to apply and where to apply. I have replaced All of my skincare and cosmetics with RMS. I love everything that I have purchased. I truly believe that you will too!!

I have super sensitive under eyes to the point where I can't even use eye creams. Almost all eye products make my under eye area puffy and/or make my eyes burn slightly. i was using a concealer that I really liked but it was a little thick. I tried this on a whim and I love it! Not only does it not cause any irritation whatsoever, it may just be the best concealer I have used. It covers beautifully while being practically indetectable. It's been a couple of weeks and still no irritation. I'm so happy to have discovered this!
Love this product!!! It brightens my eyes and my makeup looks 10 times better. Definitely a keeper:smiley:
It goes on fairly easy and disguises the bluish dark circles I inherited. Use a little at a time. I really like it!

This product seems to cover fine. My problem is with the color choices. I don't like the color all that much. Doesn't match up with my skin tone. I ordered the cherish. Only because the lightest color choice was too light and pinkish. The third choice too dark.

Feels very light and nice on this skin. Yet gives color correction . I really like that it has spf, as it can be hard to find coverage for your eye area to help prevent sun damage by the eyes. Light enough to use everyday.

I like the product. I'm using it as an eyelid and under eye base. It doesn't crease and is very smooth. But the applicator is a weird design and not helpful. I must use a brush. I also have less control over how much product is squeezed out of the tube.

The roller ball is nice and cooling. I usually use it first and then squeeze out a bit and dot it under eyes. Works nicely. Be aware that there isn't really "coverage" here". It's more of a color correction.
Amazed that this covers so well but without a cake-like finish. It does not get stuck in creases and feels great to apply with the ball applicator. So happy I purchased it!
Love, love this product. Goes on smoothly, stays put. I use it as a concealer. It's hydrating and my fav
Blends really well and actually brightens the eye area while concealing. This is truly a winner! The color I bought didn't immediately look correct but once I blended it, it looked correct.

Creamy, easily blended- this eye brightener is wonderful! I like to use my blending brush to pull any extra down to my nose area. Softens features and fine lines. Such a pretty peachy shade makes my 60+ yr old skin look radiant too!
I love the refreshing feel this product gives to my under eye area. The roller ball is amazing and refreshing.

avis.titre: Smooth finish: SPF always a must!
avis.texte: Love the roller ball definitely! The color works well and I can see a nice brightness after use. Appreciate the Tightenyl addition as I love that in the primer and it does help with smoothing out the fine lines.

avis.titre: Beautiful hydrating skincare for your eyes
avis.texte: This under eye cream does not settle into fine lines. It's creamy and feels so good on the skin. Knowing it has SPF to protect my delicate eye area is a plus. I love how it blends effortlessly and provides so much moisture. Definitely will be a staple in my makeup / skincare routine.

Stunned by this product. My skin tone is between fair and medium and I got the lightest shade which felt like a risk because I thought it might be too light and look chalky. My hope was that it would work since my under eye area tends to be bluish purple. For me, this product lightens any darkness perfectly. It doesn't cover every single bit like a mask but it lightens most of it without being heavy, settling into my skin, or looking worse in a few hours. I've been using a tiny makeup pad to blend it into my inner corner where it gets dark. My entire eye area looks better with it. I also used a dot on discoloration on my face after sunscreen and before makeup and jt was great. A week in and it's an essential even if I don't have other makeup on.

I'm so happy to be able to wear Revitalize eye brightener for the SPF, but also to help with my dark circles. I bought Cherish and it does help with lightening up my dark circles. I apply concealer to areas that need more coverage. I feel confident knowing that my eye area is protected from the sun. . It glides on smoothly and I like using the ball applicator on my puffiness before application, too. Highly recommend!
So cooling and blends right in. Brightens and depuffs. Love!!

Love the roller which helps the product to be applied smoothly and seamlessly with minimal settling or caking into fine lines. Was skeptical of the roller ball thinking it was gimmicky but was delighted at how smoothing and cooling it was on the skin. This is a color corrector but actually conceals better than any concealer I've ever used. All that and the SPF is the best part.
Amazing! Not thick at all and doesn't irritate my eyes! Every product that I tried for the eye area irritated my eyes! Finally a good one!

I can honestly say that this product does make a difference. I noticed the puffiness under my eyes was greatly reduced. My eyes were defiantly brighter and did not look so tired from lack of sleep. Very pleased with ReFresh Eye Brightener.

I need help with darkness and bags, and I've always wished for eye products with SPF. I am Light-Medium and use either Adore or Cherish, depending on the day. I love all of Rose Marie's videos and am thankful for the tips and great products!
I like it. It's a new concept for me, and I will need a little time to get the hang of using it. But the videos are helpful. The cool roller ball is a real plus.

I love this product. My daughters noticed I have been doing something different in my routine. The color was a perfect match for me and the roller ball applicator is very refreshing in this summer heat. Thank you for another incredible product.

I really love the cooling roller ball for application. It feels so good putting it on. The color blends nicely as well. I have bags and wrinkles that are hereditary, so only plastic surgery would get rid of that. This is somewhat helpful though.

I have probably 10 undereye corrector/concealers. . as none them seemed to work. This works! great on mature skin, brightens, covers the dark. Highly reccomend and I will continue to use this product and toss the others!
Love the metal applicator tip, soothing under eye where my skin is fragile and thin due aging. The color I chose is Adorable and a perfect match, also love the recommended brush too, so soft.

avis.titre: This one is not like the other ones
avis.texte: ReFresh Eye Brightener is unlike anything else I've tried for under the eye. All concealers and brighteners are either too heavy or thin, and 100% of the time they crease and pool in my fine lines. Not this! It's the perfect consistency and dries quickly into a powder-like finish. The rollerball feels really nice against the skin. I squeeze out a tiny bit of product then use the rollerball to spread it then use my ring finger to smooth it out. VoilÃ !
Nice light coverage. Like the spf. Long lasting without creasing (53). Would like it more if it was a bit more dewy and moisturizing.

I really like the feel and the coverage of this product with the added benefit of SPF, a much needed addition since I live in a hot, humid, sunny climate. I am still struggling some with a smooth, consistent application process, but I trust that will get better with practice. I no longer use additional concealer because it conceals enough of m underage blue vein issue.

Love this product and use it daily even if I am not going to put much makeup on. I love the color and it's a bonus that it has spf coverage for those delicate areas. I use it as a concealer and brightener especially under my eyes. I also use a bit around my nose as well as aging seems to increase a dark line around there making my nose appear bigger. It helps take out that bit of morning redness and even out my coloring.
Yes Yes and Yes I have been experimenting with the product; it's useful as a concealer as well. I've used it with and without makeup.
scared myself initially when it came out of the tube; thought I had selected too dark a shade. However, once I blended it in it was perfect. I used it with the RMS foundation.
Best color corrector ever! It is smoothing and cancelled out and corrected the blueness on my light complexion. Plus it has SPF. What a winning combo!

I really like this product. It does well to cover up any eye imperfections. A little goes a long way. Then it won't settle in any wrinkles. I'm a little indifferent towards the smell. But it doesn't bother me all that much.
Wow! I love this concealer! My makeup artist Becky was right when she said Cherish would be a perfect match for me. The finish is smooth and never cakey.

Finally an undereye corrector that works for for all ages. It smoothes, and stays that way all day. I bought one for my sister as well. Sometimes little things like finding a product like this can make a big difference

This eye brightener is perfection! I love the cooling aspect of the roller ball as well as the smoothness of the application. The ingredients are so clean which makes me feel good about putting something on my delicate undereye area. Another hit from RMS!

This is great for everyday use. I don't wear lots of makeup daily so this is perfect for me to just cover my dark undereye area. It makes me look fresh and brightens my face. It's not too moist or drying. I also love that the applicator feels cold. Great product for minimalist makeup with spf.

This works to smooth and protect my under eye area. It layers fantastic over my sunscreen and the radiance locking primer. It also works seamlessly with my rms concealer, because my circles are so dark I need extra help. The correction is nice and therefore I can use less concealer . It never looks cakey, crusty, or dry. It doesn't even crease. The soothing metal ball is perfect for my puffy under eyes, and the caffeine helps to depuff as much as humanly possible. It's ts pricey, but a little goes a long way. I had yried a competitor's product, but it gave me contact dermatitis. RMS did not. Winner winner chicken dinner!
I love this product. It does not sink into my wrinkles, and gives me a fresh look.

avis.titre: My brightener and concealer in one!
avis.texte: I have a tube in my purse for touch ups and a tube in the fridge that I use in the morning to make the puffiness go away. I love the adore and find it to be the perfect eye brightener and concealer in one. The ingredients in this makes it the perfect skincare makeup! That I love 💕

This is the most effective product I've ever found for hiding dark under-eye lines. Tired eyes are one of my top beauty concerns and I've tried many products that promised to help. At best they were meh. I bought this one as part of an RMS SPF bundle. I was more interested in the other products I would get, because I was skeptical about this one. Happily I was wrong. A single layer virtually makes the lines under my eyes vanish. And it's beneficial to my skin? Incredible. I love the unusual applicator tip. There appears to be plenty of product in the tube, It's so effective I haven't yet tried using it in concert with other make-up, such as foundation, concealer, or powder. Tonight I'll do full make-up and I expect good things. Rock on, Rose Marie.
It does what Rose Marie said it would, looks great on skin stays on all day, like all of her products they are amazing. Enjoy watching her and all one information on her products and how to apply.

avis.titre: Always in my make up bag in my purse!
avis.texte: My new favorite-always in my make up bag that's in my purse. This concealer is AMAZING-I bought extra for myself and I got some for my mom! The metal roller ball applicator feels amazing on my eyes as I apply it. The consistency of the product is lightweight, and can even be reapplied later in the day when I need a refresher! It even lasted during a graduation where I got rained on! I can't rave enough about it. I picked the Adore color for myself (I'm fair) and the Cherish color for my mom-who looks a bit tan compared to me.
So far love it. Having sunscreen,color corrector and a serum all in one is what I always wanted and without making my fine lines enhanced. The color is perfect.

My new go to before I leave the house! Feels so refresh ing when I apply it. Love the look of how it brightens the corners of my eyes, plus it's a bonus that it has SPF 30. By far my favorite Corrector!

I can't say enough great things about RMS' ReFresh eye brightener! I watched Rose Marie's video and was hoping it would be as impressive as it looked - it was!! It has totally brightened my eyes as Rose Marie said it would. The color, Cherish, is just beautiful! I highly recommend this product 🩷
Love it! My eyes look brighter. The area around them is smoother and clearer.
I honestly didn't know if I would like this. I really like it! One thing I have noticed is that my mascara doesn't come off under my eyes. That's a big improvement from other undereye treatments.

I like the cool applicator ball it wakes me up and brightens under eye area. I use it with a little moisturizer for light coverage then apply supernatural radiance serum to prepare for a day in the tropics.

I purchased this Eye Brightener primarily for the SPF protection it provides. I love that I can wear it alone for a natural look or layer it under concealer for extra coverage. It feels lightweight, blends easily, and helps brighten my under-eye area.
I really wanted to like this product. I have dark circles and it helps a bit, but the product creases.
Amazing! You can wear it alone or under concealer. It's so moisturizing. I love it!
This has been the best color corrector I've tried yet. Bonus with SPF The texture is lightweight & silky. The metal ball feels nice and cool.
Love it. I have loved everything I have bought. I do have some trouble with the packaging of the eyeshadows. Can't control the amount that comes out. Loose product.

I really like the Refresh Eye Brightener, but unfortunately, Adore is too light for me. I have since watched the video of Rosemary using it, and she used Cherish, which made me realize that's the color I should have ordered.
This is the best concealer/corrector i have found in a long time. I've thrown everything else out

My dark circles are a challenge for any product. I have an olive complexion with blue dark circles which have always been a problem but they are getting worse with age. I have used a concealer from RMS that I bought many years ago. It is in a tub and is the only one that really worked. This new one is in a tube and is even better because it has a bit of pink in it, so I don't look like a pasted plaster under my eyes. I will keep using it, but I wonder how long the tube will last.

avis.titre: Fantastic alone when not wearing liner
avis.texte: I live in sunny Florida and wear sunglasses almost exclusively when outdoors. The one exception is my morning walk with the dog. A neurologist suggested exposing my eyes to natural light first thing to balance circadian rhythms. I put on Refresh Eye Brightener, a quick dab of Spell lip to cheek (on lips and cheeks) and it's quite shocking how much just those quick products pick up my face! I use RMS setting powder but find I do best when applying concealer on top of the brightener before the powder when wearing full eye makeup. With just the brightener and setting powder I get some liner transfer under my lower lash line. Hence the 4 stars.
This product really helped mask the dark circles under my eyes and the rolling ball was very soothing. I did not notice any reductions in the bag though.
This is so great! It is so creamy and blends so well. It doesn't irritate my super sensitive eyes.
AMAZING !!!!! This has been my eyes best friend. I have dark, and somewhat baggie eyes. This corrector smooths, softens and adds brightness to my bags and lids. Thank Rose Marie.
Creamy formula, looks almost like a color corrector. Settled into my lines a bit, and if not blended well can look a bit orangish. Will be wearing it to the pool for sure!
I like this product. Was pleasantly surprised. I haven't used an under eye concealer in years but this one works well. Very concentrated…. doesn't take much.
Love this eye corrector. It is easy to use and looks great hiding my dark circles. Mos of all, so grateful for the beautiful clean ingredients. Thanks Rose Marie!
Finally a product that works. It does refresh my eye area plus it works for me as a concealer. I love it

avis.titre: Beautiful finish - not so beautiful smell
avis.texte: I am trying to like this. The color Cherish may be a bit dark for me. The finish is very pretty and hydrating. It does have a very bad smell. I know it is not rancid because it is newly created, however it does have a rancid smell that stays with me for about an hour after applying. I do not like leaving a review that is not "glowing" as I LOVE most RMS products.

I'm trying to get the technique of this product, as for me, I can't just apply it t my under eye area and have it look good. I tried applying it after moisturizer, and it didn't seem to work. Then I tried using it after an eye cream and that seemed to help. So it's an ongoing process.
I have only used this a couple times but it makes a huge difference. My dark circles just disappeared. I raved about it to my friends and I'm getting this for my sister for her birthday.
Absolutely amazing product! Blends well, brightens and refreshes the entire eye area, love it!
I Iove this product! It makes my eyes look refreshed and it doesn't settle in my Crows feet.

It's ok -- color is a bit to peachy, but it blends in fairly well. I do think it creases a bit and feels kind of dry on my eye. Doesn't work better than what I was using. Also the applicator/ball is not practical and isn't a good application or blending tool, IMO.

My entire beauty bag is filled with RMS products. It's the only makeup that I use since I've discovered it. I love every product I've purchased from them and this eye brightener is no exception. It goes on smoothly and blends beautifully into my skin doesn't show in the wrinkles and definitely gives my eyes a much brighter more rested look. Don't hesitate just buy it.

avis.titre: Where has this been all my life!
avis.texte: I purchased this because it included spf 30 and because of the brightening claims. It exceeded my expectations! This is exactly what I've been looking for and the color (adore) matches my skin tone perfectly. It's easy to apply and blend and it has not creased in my laugh lines throughout the day. I love watching the videos for tips and tricks. Thank you!
I do not like this, it settles into fine lines and does not have hardly any coverage, I am going to send it back, I really wanted to like it.

I love this product. It makes me look fresh, awake, and less puffy. It has completely replaced my beloved Lancome concealer. If I had to choose only one beauty product, this would be it. In fact, it's often the only make up I wear. I love it! My only criticism is that it's expensive.
Love! Very easy to use and effective in improving the look of my under eye area.
I love the way this blurs any discoloration without looking cakey or emphasizing fine lines and wrinkles. Its is perfect alone for a no makeup, my eye but better look.

I love this product. It's lightweight, and the metal roller ball really does help minimize my under-eye circles and puffiness. Even though it feels and looks lightweight, it still gives surprisingly great coverage. Best of all, it doesn't settle into the fine lines under my eyes, which is hard to find in an under-eye product. It leaves my eyes looking brighter, smoother, and more refreshed without feeling heavy or cakey.

avis.titre: 8 hrs of sleep in a tube
avis.texte: Brightens entire eye area with cooling, gentle roller ball applicator.
So far, I'm liking this a lot. It's a little thinner in than I expected, but I love the concept of using the ball to help with dark circles.
The best! Super hydrating, clean ingredients, totally hides dark circles, brightens & tightens. Love this product!
